title: Shinonome Akito — Huddle Of Resolve〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After RAD BLAST
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys all have your drinks?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: We're all set over here too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, here's to RAD BLAST succeeding. Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'll keep bringing out the food and drinks, so have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us use your place and cooking all this food for us, Ken.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You're welcome, but I thought you guys gathering here to celebrate successful events was a given at this point.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, I've also noticed how your after-parties quickly turn into debriefs... You won't be doing that today, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, definitely not today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha.
We gotta have a big celebration today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I'm really happy about our group coming back together with a certain someone deciding to return!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm just glad that you were willing to welcome me back.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Plus, we've got a special guest here today!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. I really need to thank you guys again for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We should be the ones thanking you.
I mean, we really wanted you to be here.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe how awesome today's event was!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Just thinking about that atmosphere... It really did feel like a dream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, want me to pinch your cheek?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I already tried, and it hurt...
This is the real world, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Finding out that this is all a dream would be the worst... On the other hand, we'd just have to go and blow everyone away again.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, the pizza's ready.
Come and get it while it's hot!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I'll have a slice.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, I want a slice too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't push...
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(...?
He's by himself...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm just glad that you were willing to welcome me back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Um, Ken?
Can I ask you for a quick favor...?
A few minutes later
se_walk_men_004_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Tono.
What are you doing here all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I was just soaking in what was going on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
I was worried that you felt bad about coming back at the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, Mita, Okazaki and EVER felt really bad about disappearing for a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why I thought you were feeling the same way... But I guess my worries were misplaced.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: After all, you're not really one to be that sensitive to what people are thinking.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Wait, give me a little credit...
I'm a lot more empathetic than you think.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What? Says who?
The first time we met, you insulted us left and right.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Haha. Yes, I remember. That all feels like so long ago now.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: To think that we'd end up working together and achieving this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't have believed it back then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your partner's song and the way you sang today. They were both amazing.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, Tono, get over here!
Ken just made you a special parfait!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Hm? A parfait...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hear that? Go check it out.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Now I see...
I really can't thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, be right here!
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That guy...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, that was pretty nice of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? How long have you guys been there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not long. We just happened to overhear you asking my dad to make a chocolate parfait for Arata.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was very like you to ask for that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, this is supposed to be a party.
It didn't seem right to just leave him alone after seeing that complicated look on his face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, Akito, Ken apparently made everyone some pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, let's go back to where the others are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that your hook...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I guess we should have them since he went to the trouble.
